verdict.rationale: CDP docs explicitly describe provisioning 'stable onchain addresses' that auto-credit a custodial account (dedicated deposit addresses), and webhooks can watch up to 100 wallet addresses per subscription, which supports per-customer address-based reconciliation. However, there's no explicit documentation of named virtual accounts for fiat, nor clear guidance on mapping addresses to specific customer IDs for reconciliation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer/customer-ID tagging or named virtual account docs, fiat-side dedicated account numbers, and independent/hands-on confirmation of reconciliation accuracy at scale.
